capabilities: Detect the language of code blocks lacking a language tag
Apply the detected language tag to enable syntax highlighting
Run detection on open, on edit, on save, or via manual commands
Undo individual or all past detections from a history browser
Configure detection methods, confidence threshold, and processing scope
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian code blocks without a language tag get no syntax highlighting, and fixing many untagged blocks by hand across a vault is tedious.

relations.evidence: Utilizes the proven Highlight.js library for precise language recognition

summary: Code block language detector that identifies the programming language of untagged code blocks and adds language tags for syntax highlighting.
